findings.summary: Official OpenTinker has a protected pre-paper feat/sciworld-support branch with ScienceWorld client/eval/RL/config/environment files and March 12, 2026 history; current-main absence does not imply official historical absence.

The public ScienceWorld branch is only a source precursor: its default training config uses 1000 steps, max_steps 30 and empty simplification_str, while Auto-Dreamer Table 6 reports 200 steps, max environment steps 50 and teleport/openDoors/self-watering simplifications. Exact paper-run source/config binding remains unresolved.

No opentinker/memory_training path was found in inspected main, feat/sciworld-support, paper_repri, support-co-evolve or support-co-evolve-v2 trees, and current GitHub code indexing exposes no dreamer_calls.jsonl; the memory-training implementation and historical run-export bundle remain unlocated on tested surfaces.

GitHub commits-by-path returns an empty history for opentinker/memory_training on both main and feat/sciworld-support ancestry; this narrows those two histories but does not rule out unmerged branches, forks, mirrors or unreachable history.
